source_units.text: In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.
source_units.display_text: In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.

source_units.text: The Lord handed the city into his hands, together with Joakim king of Judea and a portion of the Lord’s sacred vessels. He carried them away to Babylon and deposited them in his idol-temple.
source_units.display_text: The Lord handed the city into his hands, together with Joakim king of Judea and a portion of the Lord’s sacred vessels. He carried them away to Babylon and deposited them in his idol-temple.

source_units.text: The king told Abiesdri, his chief eunuch, to bring him some of the sons of Israel’s magnates, of the royal family and of the chosen men:
source_units.display_text: The king told Abiesdri, his chief eunuch, to bring him some of the sons of Israel’s magnates, of the royal family and of the chosen men:

source_units.text: young men without blemish, handsome, knowledgeable in every kind of wisdom, literate, intelligent, wise, and strong enough to be in the king’s house, and to teach them letters and the Chaldean tongue,
source_units.display_text: young men without blemish, handsome, knowledgeable in every kind of wisdom, literate, intelligent, wise, and strong enough to be in the king’s house, and to teach them letters and the Chaldean tongue,

source_units.text: and to give them a ration from the king’s house each day, from the royal table and the wine the king drank, and to educate them for three years and place some of them before the king.
source_units.display_text: and to give them a ration from the king’s house each day, from the royal table and the wine the king drank, and to educate them for three years and place some of them before the king.

source_units.text: Among the lineage of Israel’s sons from Judea were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
source_units.display_text: Among the lineage of Israel’s sons from Judea were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

source_units.text: The chief eunuch assigned them names: Daniel, Baltasar; Hananiah, Sedrach; Mishael, Misach; and Azariah, Abdenago.
source_units.display_text: The chief eunuch assigned them names: Daniel, Baltasar; Hananiah, Sedrach; Mishael, Misach; and Azariah, Abdenago.

source_units.text: Daniel considered in his heart how he might avoid being polluted by the king’s dinner and the wine he drank, and petitioned the chief eunuch that he might not be contaminated.
source_units.display_text: Daniel considered in his heart how he might avoid being polluted by the king’s dinner and the wine he drank, and petitioned the chief eunuch that he might not be contaminated.

source_units.text: The Lord gave Daniel honor and favor before the chief eunuch.
source_units.display_text: The Lord gave Daniel honor and favor before the chief eunuch.

source_units.text: The chief eunuch said to Daniel, “I am anxious about my lord the king, who prescribed your food and drink, lest he see your faces drawn and weak beside the foreign youths being reared with you, and I risk my own neck.”
source_units.display_text: The chief eunuch said to Daniel, “I am anxious about my lord the king, who prescribed your food and drink, lest he see your faces drawn and weak beside the foreign youths being reared with you, and I risk my own neck.”

source_units.text: Daniel said to Abiesdri, appointed chief eunuch over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
source_units.display_text: Daniel said to Abiesdri, appointed chief eunuch over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

source_units.text: “Test your servants for ten days, and let us be given legumes from the earth to eat, and water to drink.
source_units.display_text: “Test your servants for ten days, and let us be given legumes from the earth to eat, and water to drink.

source_units.text: If our appearance looks drawn beside the other young men eating the royal dinner, then deal with your servants however you wish.”
source_units.display_text: If our appearance looks drawn beside the other young men eating the royal dinner, then deal with your servants however you wish.”

source_units.text: He dealt with them in this manner and tested them for ten days.
source_units.display_text: He dealt with them in this manner and tested them for ten days.

source_units.text: After ten days their appearance was good and their bodily condition better than the other young men eating the royal dinner.
source_units.display_text: After ten days their appearance was good and their bodily condition better than the other young men eating the royal dinner.

source_units.text: Abiesdri kept removing their dinner and wine and giving them legumes in exchange.
source_units.display_text: Abiesdri kept removing their dinner and wine and giving them legumes in exchange.

source_units.text: The Lord gave the young men knowledge, understanding, and practical wisdom in every literary skill; to Daniel He gave understanding in every utterance, vision, dreams, and all wisdom.
source_units.display_text: The Lord gave the young men knowledge, understanding, and practical wisdom in every literary skill; to Daniel He gave understanding in every utterance, vision, dreams, and all wisdom.

source_units.text: After these days the king ordered them brought in, and the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.
source_units.display_text: After these days the king ordered them brought in, and the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.

source_units.text: The king conversed with them, and among the wise no one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. They remained beside the king.
source_units.display_text: The king conversed with them, and among the wise no one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. They remained beside the king.

source_units.text: In every matter of discourse, understanding, and education about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times wiser than the learned experts and philosophers throughout his kingdom. The king honored them, appointed them rulers, and declared them wiser than all his own men in affairs throughout his land and kingdom.
source_units.display_text: In every matter of discourse, understanding, and education about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times wiser than the learned experts and philosophers throughout his kingdom. The king honored them, appointed them rulers, and declared them wiser than all his own men in affairs throughout his land and kingdom.

source_units.text: Daniel remained until the first year of the reign of Cyrus king of the Persians.
source_units.display_text: Daniel remained until the first year of the reign of Cyrus king of the Persians.

source_units.text: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, the king fell into visions and dreams and was disturbed in his dream, and his sleep left him.
source_units.display_text: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, the king fell into visions and dreams and was disturbed in his dream, and his sleep left him.

source_units.text: The king ordered the incantation-singers, magi, and sorcerers of the Chaldeans brought in to report his dreams to him. They arrived and stood beside the king.
source_units.display_text: The king ordered the incantation-singers, magi, and sorcerers of the Chaldeans brought in to report his dreams to him. They arrived and stood beside the king.

source_units.text: The king said to them, “I have seen a dream, and my spirit was stirred; therefore I wish to understand the dream.”
source_units.display_text: The king said to them, “I have seen a dream, and my spirit was stirred; therefore I wish to understand the dream.”

source_units.text: The Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language: “My lord king, live for ever! Report your dream to your servants, and we will explain its interpretation to you.”
source_units.display_text: The Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language: “My lord king, live for ever! Report your dream to your servants, and we will explain its interpretation to you.”

source_units.text: The king answered the Chaldeans, “Unless you truthfully report the dream to me and disclose its interpretation, you will be made a public example, and your possessions will be taken into the royal treasury.
source_units.display_text: The king answered the Chaldeans, “Unless you truthfully report the dream to me and disclose its interpretation, you will be made a public example, and your possessions will be taken into the royal treasury.

source_units.text: But if you make the dream clear to me and report its interpretation, you will receive gifts of every kind and be honored by me. Disclose the dream to me and interpret it.”
source_units.display_text: But if you make the dream clear to me and report its interpretation, you will receive gifts of every kind and be honored by me. Disclose the dream to me and interpret it.”

source_units.text: They answered a second time, “O king, state the vision, and your servants will interpret accordingly.”
source_units.display_text: They answered a second time, “O king, state the vision, and your servants will interpret accordingly.”

source_units.text: The king said to them, “I know for certain that you are buying time, since you have seen that the matter has departed from me. As I have commanded, so it will be.
source_units.display_text: The king said to them, “I know for certain that you are buying time, since you have seen that the matter has departed from me. As I have commanded, so it will be.

source_units.text: Unless you truthfully report the dream and disclose its interpretation, you will meet death. You have agreed together to speak false words before me until the time changes. Now, if you tell me what I saw during the night, I will know that you can also disclose its interpretation.”
source_units.display_text: Unless you truthfully report the dream and disclose its interpretation, you will meet death. You have agreed together to speak false words before me until the time changes. Now, if you tell me what I saw during the night, I will know that you can also disclose its interpretation.”

source_units.text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, “No one on earth can tell the king what he has seen, as you ask. No king and no ruler asks such a thing of any wise man, magus, or Chaldean.
source_units.display_text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, “No one on earth can tell the king what he has seen, as you ask. No king and no ruler asks such a thing of any wise man, magus, or Chaldean.

source_units.text: The matter you seek, O king, is weighty and extraordinary. No one can disclose these things to the king except perhaps an angel, whose dwelling is not with any flesh. Therefore it cannot happen as you suppose.”
source_units.display_text: The matter you seek, O king, is weighty and extraordinary. No one can disclose these things to the king except perhaps an angel, whose dwelling is not with any flesh. Therefore it cannot happen as you suppose.”

source_units.text: Then the king became gloomy and deeply grieved and ordered all the wise men of Babylonia brought out.
source_units.display_text: Then the king became gloomy and deeply grieved and ordered all the wise men of Babylonia brought out.

source_units.text: It was decreed that all should be killed, and Daniel and everyone with him were sought so that they might perish together.
source_units.display_text: It was decreed that all should be killed, and Daniel and everyone with him were sought so that they might perish together.

source_units.text: Then Daniel shared his counsel and judgment with Arioch, the king’s chief cook, who had been ordered to bring out Babylonia’s learned men,
source_units.display_text: Then Daniel shared his counsel and judgment with Arioch, the king’s chief cook, who had been ordered to bring out Babylonia’s learned men,

source_units.text: and questioned him, saying, “On what matter is such a bitter decree being issued by the king?” Then Arioch explained the command to Daniel.
source_units.display_text: and questioned him, saying, “On what matter is such a bitter decree being issued by the king?” Then Arioch explained the command to Daniel.

source_units.text: Daniel quickly went in to the king and petitioned for time from the king, so that he might disclose everything before him.
source_units.display_text: Daniel quickly went in to the king and petitioned for time from the king, so that he might disclose everything before him.

source_units.text: Then Daniel went to his house and explained everything to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
source_units.display_text: Then Daniel went to his house and explained everything to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

source_units.text: He called for fasting and supplication and for help to be sought from the Lord Most High concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and those with him would not be handed over to destruction with Babylon’s learned men.
source_units.display_text: He called for fasting and supplication and for help to be sought from the Lord Most High concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and those with him would not be handed over to destruction with Babylon’s learned men.

source_units.text: Then, in a vision that very night, the king’s mystery was plainly revealed to Daniel. Daniel blessed the Lord Most High,
source_units.display_text: Then, in a vision that very night, the king’s mystery was plainly revealed to Daniel. Daniel blessed the Lord Most High,

source_units.text: and cried out, “The name of the great Lord will be blessed for ever, because wisdom and majesty belong to Him.
source_units.display_text: and cried out, “The name of the great Lord will be blessed for ever, because wisdom and majesty belong to Him.

source_units.text: He changes seasons and times, transfers kings and appoints them, gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to those who possess knowledge,
source_units.display_text: He changes seasons and times, transfers kings and appoints them, gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to those who possess knowledge,

source_units.text: reveals deep and dark things, knows what is in darkness and what is in light, and with Him is a dwelling.
source_units.display_text: reveals deep and dark things, knows what is in darkness and what is in light, and with Him is a dwelling.

source_units.text: To Thee, Lord of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because Thou hast given me wisdom and prudence. Now Thou hast shown me everything I requested, to disclose these things to the king.”
source_units.display_text: To Thee, Lord of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because Thou hast given me wisdom and prudence. Now Thou hast shown me everything I requested, to disclose these things to the king.”

source_units.text: Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill all Babylonia’s learned men, and said, “Do not destroy Babylonia’s learned men. Bring me to the king, and I will disclose every detail to him.”
source_units.display_text: Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill all Babylonia’s learned men, and said, “Do not destroy Babylonia’s learned men. Bring me to the king, and I will disclose every detail to him.”

source_units.text: Then Arioch urgently brought Daniel to the king and said, “I have found a wise man from the captivity of the sons of Judea who will disclose every detail to the king.”
source_units.display_text: Then Arioch urgently brought Daniel to the king and said, “I have found a wise man from the captivity of the sons of Judea who will disclose every detail to the king.”

source_units.text: The king answered Daniel, who was called Baltasar in Chaldean, “Will you be able to disclose to me the vision I saw and its interpretation?”
source_units.display_text: The king answered Daniel, who was called Baltasar in Chaldean, “Will you be able to disclose to me the vision I saw and its interpretation?”

source_units.text: Daniel spoke aloud before the king, “Disclosure of the mystery the king saw does not belong to wise men, sorcerers, incantation-singers, or gazarenes,
source_units.display_text: Daniel spoke aloud before the king, “Disclosure of the mystery the king saw does not belong to wise men, sorcerers, incantation-singers, or gazarenes,

source_units.text: but there is a God in heaven who uncovers mysteries, who has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what must happen in the last days. O king, live for ever! This is the dream and the vision of your head upon your bed:
source_units.display_text: but there is a God in heaven who uncovers mysteries, who has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what must happen in the last days. O king, live for ever! This is the dream and the vision of your head upon your bed:

source_units.text: You, O king, reclining upon your bed, saw everything that must happen in the last days, and the Revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what must happen.
source_units.display_text: You, O king, reclining upon your bed, saw everything that must happen in the last days, and the Revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what must happen.

source_units.text: This mystery was revealed to me because of no wisdom in me beyond all people; rather, so that it might be disclosed to the king, what you conceived in your heart was made known to me.
source_units.display_text: This mystery was revealed to me because of no wisdom in me beyond all people; rather, so that it might be disclosed to the king, what you conceived in your heart was made known to me.

source_units.text: You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.
source_units.display_text: You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.

source_units.text: Its head was good gold, its chest and arms silver, and its belly and thighs bronze,
source_units.display_text: Its head was good gold, its chest and arms silver, and its belly and thighs bronze,

source_units.text: its legs iron, and its feet partly iron and partly earthenware.
source_units.display_text: its legs iron, and its feet partly iron and partly earthenware.

source_units.text: You watched until a stone was cut from a mountain without hands. It struck the image on its feet of iron and earthenware and ground them down.
source_units.display_text: You watched until a stone was cut from a mountain without hands. It struck the image on its feet of iron and earthenware and ground them down.

source_units.text: Then the iron, earthenware, bronze, silver, and gold were ground fine together, becoming finer than chaff on a threshing floor. The wind scattered them so that nothing remained of them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and struck the whole earth.
source_units.display_text: Then the iron, earthenware, bronze, silver, and gold were ground fine together, becoming finer than chaff on a threshing floor. The wind scattered them so that nothing remained of them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and struck the whole earth.

source_units.text: This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.
source_units.display_text: This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.

source_units.text: You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.
source_units.display_text: You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.

source_units.text: Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.
source_units.display_text: Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.

source_units.text: After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.
source_units.display_text: After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.

source_units.text: A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.
source_units.display_text: A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.

source_units.text: As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.
source_units.display_text: As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.

source_units.text: The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.
source_units.display_text: The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.

source_units.text: As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.
source_units.display_text: As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.

source_units.text: In the times of these kings the God of heaven will establish another kingdom, which will exist for ever and will not be destroyed. This kingdom will not leave another nation; it will strike and obliterate these kingdoms and will itself stand for ever,
source_units.display_text: In the times of these kings the God of heaven will establish another kingdom, which will exist for ever and will not be destroyed. This kingdom will not leave another nation; it will strike and obliterate these kingdoms and will itself stand for ever,

source_units.text: just as you saw a stone cut from a mountain without hands, pounding together the earthenware, iron, bronze, silver, and gold. The great God has shown the king what will happen in the last days. The vision is exact, and its interpretation trustworthy.”
source_units.display_text: just as you saw a stone cut from a mountain without hands, pounding together the earthenware, iron, bronze, silver, and gold. The great God has shown the king what will happen in the last days. The vision is exact, and its interpretation trustworthy.”

source_units.text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell face down on the ground and prostrated himself before Daniel. He ordered sacrifices and libations made to him.
source_units.display_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell face down on the ground and prostrated himself before Daniel. He ordered sacrifices and libations made to him.

source_units.text: The king spoke aloud to Daniel, “Truly your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, the One who alone brings hidden mysteries to light, because you have been able to disclose this mystery.”
source_units.display_text: The king spoke aloud to Daniel, “Truly your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, the One who alone brings hidden mysteries to light, because you have been able to disclose this mystery.”

source_units.text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar exalted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, placed him over Babylonia’s affairs, and appointed him ruler and leader of all Babylonia’s learned men.
source_units.display_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar exalted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, placed him over Babylonia’s affairs, and appointed him ruler and leader of all Babylonia’s learned men.

source_units.text: Daniel petitioned the king that Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago be appointed over Babylonia’s affairs. Daniel remained in the royal court.
source_units.display_text: Daniel petitioned the king that Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago be appointed over Babylonia’s affairs. Daniel remained in the royal court.

source_units.text: In the eighteenth year, King Nebuchadnezzar, who administered cities and countries and all who inhabited the earth from India to Ethiopia, made a golden image, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide. He set it up on the plain of the enclosure in the country of Babylonia.
source_units.display_text: In the eighteenth year, King Nebuchadnezzar, who administered cities and countries and all who inhabited the earth from India to Ethiopia, made a golden image, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide. He set it up on the plain of the enclosure in the country of Babylonia.

source_units.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of kings and lord of the whole inhabited world, sent to gather all the nations, tribes, and languages, satraps, generals, district governors, consuls, administrators, those holding authority in each country, and everyone throughout the inhabited world, to come to the dedication of the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
source_units.display_text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of kings and lord of the whole inhabited world, sent to gather all the nations, tribes, and languages, satraps, generals, district governors, consuls, administrators, those holding authority in each country, and everyone throughout the inhabited world, to come to the dedication of the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

source_units.text: Those previously listed stood opposite the image.
source_units.display_text: Those previously listed stood opposite the image.

source_units.text: The herald proclaimed to the crowds, “You are commanded, nations and countries, peoples and languages:
source_units.display_text: The herald proclaimed to the crowds, “You are commanded, nations and countries, peoples and languages:

source_units.text: when you hear the sound of trumpet, panpipe, kithara, sambuca, psaltery, symphonia, and every kind of musical instrument, fall down and bow to the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
source_units.display_text: when you hear the sound of trumpet, panpipe, kithara, sambuca, psaltery, symphonia, and every kind of musical instrument, fall down and bow to the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

source_units.text: They will throw into the blazing furnace anyone who does not fall down and bow.”
source_units.display_text: They will throw into the blazing furnace anyone who does not fall down and bow.”

source_units.text: At that time, when all the nations heard the sound of the trumpet and every musical sound, all the nations, tribes, and languages fell down and bowed to the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up before him.
source_units.display_text: At that time, when all the nations heard the sound of the trumpet and every musical sound, all the nations, tribes, and languages fell down and bowed to the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up before him.

source_units.text: At that time Chaldean men came forward and accused the Jews.
source_units.display_text: At that time Chaldean men came forward and accused the Jews.

source_units.text: They spoke and said, “My lord king, live for ever!
source_units.display_text: They spoke and said, “My lord king, live for ever!

source_units.text: You, O king, commanded and decreed that everyone who hears the trumpet and every musical sound must fall down and bow to the golden image.
source_units.display_text: You, O king, commanded and decreed that everyone who hears the trumpet and every musical sound must fall down and bow to the golden image.

source_units.text: Whoever does not fall down and bow will be thrown into the blazing furnace.
source_units.display_text: Whoever does not fall down and bow will be thrown into the blazing furnace.

source_units.text: There are certain Jewish men whom you appointed over the country of Babylonia—Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago. Those men have not feared your command; they have not served your idol or bowed to your golden image that you set up.”
source_units.display_text: There are certain Jewish men whom you appointed over the country of Babylonia—Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago. Those men have not feared your command; they have not served your idol or bowed to your golden image that you set up.”

source_units.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar, angered with wrath, ordered Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago brought in. The men were brought to the king.
source_units.display_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar, angered with wrath, ordered Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago brought in. The men were brought to the king.

source_units.text: When King Nebuchadnezzar saw them, he said to them, “Why, Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, do you not serve my gods or bow to the golden image I set up?
source_units.display_text: When King Nebuchadnezzar saw them, he said to them, “Why, Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, do you not serve my gods or bow to the golden image I set up?

source_units.text: Now, if you are ready, as soon as you hear the trumpet and every musical sound, to fall down and bow to the golden image I set up—but if not, know that unless you bow, you will immediately be thrown into the blazing furnace. What god will rescue you from my hands?”
source_units.display_text: Now, if you are ready, as soon as you hear the trumpet and every musical sound, to fall down and bow to the golden image I set up—but if not, know that unless you bow, you will immediately be thrown into the blazing furnace. What god will rescue you from my hands?”

source_units.text: Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago answered King Nebuchadnezzar, “O king, we have no need to answer you concerning this command.
source_units.display_text: Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago answered King Nebuchadnezzar, “O king, we have no need to answer you concerning this command.

source_units.text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.
source_units.display_text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.

source_units.text: Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”
source_units.display_text: Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”

source_units.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with fury, and the appearance of his face changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times beyond what it needed to be heated.
source_units.display_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with fury, and the appearance of his face changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times beyond what it needed to be heated.

source_units.text: He ordered the strongest men in his force to bind Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago hand and foot and throw them into the blazing furnace.
source_units.display_text: He ordered the strongest men in his force to bind Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago hand and foot and throw them into the blazing furnace.

source_units.text: Then those men were bound hand and foot, wearing their footwear and the tiaras on their heads, together with their clothing, and were thrown into the furnace.
source_units.display_text: Then those men were bound hand and foot, wearing their footwear and the tiaras on their heads, together with their clothing, and were thrown into the furnace.

source_units.text: Because the king’s command was urgent and the furnace had been heated seven times beyond its earlier heat, the appointed men bound them hand and foot, brought them to the furnace, and threw them into it.
source_units.display_text: Because the king’s command was urgent and the furnace had been heated seven times beyond its earlier heat, the appointed men bound them hand and foot, brought them to the furnace, and threw them into it.

source_units.text: The flame came out of the furnace and burned and killed the men who had bound Azariah and his companions; but they themselves were preserved.
source_units.display_text: The flame came out of the furnace and burned and killed the men who had bound Azariah and his companions; but they themselves were preserved.

source_units.text: Thus Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael prayed and sang to the Lord when the king ordered them thrown into the furnace.
source_units.display_text: Thus Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael prayed and sang to the Lord when the king ordered them thrown into the furnace.

source_units.text: Azariah stood and prayed in this manner. Opening his mouth, he gave thanks to the Lord together with his companions amid the fire, while the Chaldeans were fiercely stoking the furnace. They said:
source_units.display_text: Azariah stood and prayed in this manner. Opening his mouth, he gave thanks to the Lord together with his companions amid the fire, while the Chaldeans were fiercely stoking the furnace. They said:

source_units.text: “Blessed art Thou, Lord, God of our fathers; Thy name is praised and glorified for ever.
source_units.display_text: “Blessed art Thou, Lord, God of our fathers; Thy name is praised and glorified for ever.

source_units.text: For Thou art righteous in everything Thou hast done to us; all Thy works are true, Thy ways upright, and all Thy judgments true.
source_units.display_text: For Thou art righteous in everything Thou hast done to us; all Thy works are true, Thy ways upright, and all Thy judgments true.

source_units.text: Thou hast carried out judgments of truth in everything Thou didst bring upon us and upon Thy holy city, our fathers’ Jerusalem. For in truth and judgment Thou didst all these things because of our sins.
source_units.display_text: Thou hast carried out judgments of truth in everything Thou didst bring upon us and upon Thy holy city, our fathers’ Jerusalem. For in truth and judgment Thou didst all these things because of our sins.

source_units.text: For we have sinned in everything and acted lawlessly by departing from Thee. We have sinned in everything and have not obeyed the commands of Thy law.
source_units.display_text: For we have sinned in everything and acted lawlessly by departing from Thee. We have sinned in everything and have not obeyed the commands of Thy law.

source_units.text: We have neither kept nor done what Thou didst command us, so that it might go well with us.
source_units.display_text: We have neither kept nor done what Thou didst command us, so that it might go well with us.

source_units.text: And now, everything Thou hast brought upon us and everything Thou hast done to us, Thou hast done in true judgment.
source_units.display_text: And now, everything Thou hast brought upon us and everything Thou hast done to us, Thou hast done in true judgment.

source_units.text: Thou didst hand us over to our enemies, lawless and most hateful apostates, and to an unjust king, the most wicked in all the earth.
source_units.display_text: Thou didst hand us over to our enemies, lawless and most hateful apostates, and to an unjust king, the most wicked in all the earth.

source_units.text: Now we cannot open our mouths; shame and reproach have come upon Thy servants and those who revere Thee.
source_units.display_text: Now we cannot open our mouths; shame and reproach have come upon Thy servants and those who revere Thee.

source_units.text: Do not hand us over utterly, for Thy name’s sake; do not dissolve Thy covenant.
source_units.display_text: Do not hand us over utterly, for Thy name’s sake; do not dissolve Thy covenant.

source_units.text: Do not remove Thy mercy from us, for the sake of Abraham, beloved by Thee, and Isaac Thy servant, and Israel Thy holy one,
source_units.display_text: Do not remove Thy mercy from us, for the sake of Abraham, beloved by Thee, and Isaac Thy servant, and Israel Thy holy one,

source_units.text: as Thou didst speak to them, saying that Thou wouldst multiply their descendants like the stars of heaven and the sand along the shore of the sea.
source_units.display_text: as Thou didst speak to them, saying that Thou wouldst multiply their descendants like the stars of heaven and the sand along the shore of the sea.

source_units.text: For, Master, we have been diminished beyond all nations, and today we are lowly throughout the earth because of our sins.
source_units.display_text: For, Master, we have been diminished beyond all nations, and today we are lowly throughout the earth because of our sins.

source_units.text: At this time there is no ruler or prophet or leader, no burnt offering or sacrifice or offering or incense, no place to offer produce before Thee and find mercy.
source_units.display_text: At this time there is no ruler or prophet or leader, no burnt offering or sacrifice or offering or incense, no place to offer produce before Thee and find mercy.

source_units.text: But with a crushed soul and humbled spirit may we be accepted, as with burnt offerings of rams and bulls, and as with tens of thousands of fat lambs.
source_units.display_text: But with a crushed soul and humbled spirit may we be accepted, as with burnt offerings of rams and bulls, and as with tens of thousands of fat lambs.

source_units.text: So may our sacrifice be before Thee today; and be propitious—“behind Thee”; for there is no shame for those who trust in Thee; and bring to completion—“behind Thee.”
source_units.display_text: So may our sacrifice be before Thee today; and be propitious—“behind Thee”; for there is no shame for those who trust in Thee; and bring to completion—“behind Thee.”

source_units.text: Now we follow with our whole heart; we fear Thee and seek Thy face. Do not put us to shame,
source_units.display_text: Now we follow with our whole heart; we fear Thee and seek Thy face. Do not put us to shame,

source_units.text: but deal with us according to Thy gentleness and the abundance of Thy mercy.
source_units.display_text: but deal with us according to Thy gentleness and the abundance of Thy mercy.

source_units.text: Rescue us according to Thy wondrous deeds, and give glory to Thy name, Lord.
source_units.display_text: Rescue us according to Thy wondrous deeds, and give glory to Thy name, Lord.

source_units.text: May all who inflict evil on Thy servants be ashamed; may they be humiliated out of all their power, and may their strength be crushed.
source_units.display_text: May all who inflict evil on Thy servants be ashamed; may they be humiliated out of all their power, and may their strength be crushed.

source_units.text: Let them know that Thou alone art Lord, God, glorious over the whole inhabited world.”
source_units.display_text: Let them know that Thou alone art Lord, God, glorious over the whole inhabited world.”

source_units.text: The king’s servants who threw them in did not stop heating the furnace. When they threw the three together into the furnace, the furnace was sevenfold ablaze in its heat. When they threw them in, those casting them were above them, while others stoked beneath them with naphtha, tow, pitch, and vine brushwood.

source_units.text: The flame spread above the furnace for forty-nine cubits.
source_units.display_text: The flame spread above the furnace for forty-nine cubits.

source_units.text: It spread out and burned those Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.
source_units.display_text: It spread out and burned those Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.

source_units.text: An angel of the Lord descended into the furnace together with Azariah and his companions and shook the flame of fire out of the furnace.
source_units.display_text: An angel of the Lord descended into the furnace together with Azariah and his companions and shook the flame of fire out of the furnace.

source_units.text: He made the middle of the furnace like a dew-laden breeze whistling through. The fire did not touch them at all; it neither distressed nor troubled them.

source_units.text: Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael, bless the Lord; sing praise to Him and exalt Him highly for ever. For He rescued us from Hades and saved us from the hand of death; He delivered us from the midst of the burning flame and redeemed us from the fire.

source_units.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures for ever.
source_units.display_text: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures for ever.

source_units.text: Bless, all who revere the God of gods; sing praise and give thanks, for His mercy endures for ever and for the age of ages.”
source_units.display_text: Bless, all who revere the God of gods; sing praise and give thanks, for His mercy endures for ever and for the age of ages.”

source_units.text: When the king heard them singing and, standing, observed them alive, King Nebuchadnezzar was astonished, rose in haste, and said to his friends:
source_units.display_text: When the king heard them singing and, standing, observed them alive, King Nebuchadnezzar was astonished, rose in haste, and said to his friends:

source_units.text: “Behold! I see four men unbound, walking in the fire, and no harm has come upon them. The fourth has the likeness of an angel of God.”
source_units.display_text: “Behold! I see four men unbound, walking in the fire, and no harm has come upon them. The fourth has the likeness of an angel of God.”

source_units.text: The king approached the door of the furnace blazing with fire and called them by name: “Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, servants of the Most High God of gods, come out of the fire!” Thus the men came out from the midst of the fire.
source_units.display_text: The king approached the door of the furnace blazing with fire and called them by name: “Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, servants of the Most High God of gods, come out of the fire!” Thus the men came out from the midst of the fire.

source_units.text: The consuls, district governors, ancestral chiefs, and the king’s friends gathered. They observed those men: the fire had not touched their bodies, their hair had not burned, their trousers were unchanged, and there was no smell of fire on them.
source_units.display_text: The consuls, district governors, ancestral chiefs, and the king’s friends gathered. They observed those men: the fire had not touched their bodies, their hair had not burned, their trousers were unchanged, and there was no smell of fire on them.

source_units.text: King Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, who sent His angel and saved His servants who hoped in Him. They rejected the king’s command and surrendered their bodies to burning so that they would neither serve nor bow to another god except their own God.
source_units.display_text: King Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, who sent His angel and saved His servants who hoped in Him. They rejected the king’s command and surrendered their bodies to burning so that they would neither serve nor bow to another god except their own God.

source_units.text: Now I decree: from every nation, every tribe, and every language, whoever blasphemes the Lord, the God of Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, will be dismembered and his house confiscated, because there is no other god who can rescue like this.”
source_units.display_text: Now I decree: from every nation, every tribe, and every language, whoever blasphemes the Lord, the God of Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, will be dismembered and his house confiscated, because there is no other god who can rescue like this.”

source_units.text: Thus the king gave Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago authority over the whole country and appointed them rulers.
source_units.display_text: Thus the king gave Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago authority over the whole country and appointed them rulers.

source_units.text: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, he said, “I was at peace in my house and prospering upon my throne.
source_units.display_text: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, he said, “I was at peace in my house and prospering upon my throne.

source_units.text: I saw a dream and became apprehensive; fear fell upon me.
source_units.display_text: I saw a dream and became apprehensive; fear fell upon me.

source_units.text: I was sleeping, and there was a tall tree growing upon the earth. Its appearance was great, and no other was like it.
source_units.display_text: I was sleeping, and there was a tall tree growing upon the earth. Its appearance was great, and no other was like it.

source_units.text: Its appearance was great: its top reached to heaven, and its mass to the clouds, filling what lay beneath heaven. The sun and moon dwelt in it and illuminated the whole earth.
source_units.display_text: Its appearance was great: its top reached to heaven, and its mass to the clouds, filling what lay beneath heaven. The sun and moon dwelt in it and illuminated the whole earth.

source_units.text: Its branches were about thirty stadia long. All the wild animals of the earth found shade beneath it, and the birds of heaven nested in it. Its fruit was abundant and good, and it supplied all living creatures.
source_units.display_text: Its branches were about thirty stadia long. All the wild animals of the earth found shade beneath it, and the birds of heaven nested in it. Its fruit was abundant and good, and it supplied all living creatures.

source_units.text: I was watching in my sleep, and an angel was sent in strength from heaven.
source_units.display_text: I was watching in my sleep, and an angel was sent in strength from heaven.

source_units.text: He called out and said to it, ‘Cut it down and destroy it, for the Most High has commanded that it be uprooted and rendered useless.’
source_units.display_text: He called out and said to it, ‘Cut it down and destroy it, for the Most High has commanded that it be uprooted and rendered useless.’

source_units.text: He spoke in this way: ‘Leave one root of it in the earth, so that it may graze on grass like an ox with the wild animals of the earth in the mountains;
source_units.display_text: He spoke in this way: ‘Leave one root of it in the earth, so that it may graze on grass like an ox with the wild animals of the earth in the mountains;

source_units.text: let his body be changed by heaven’s dew, and let him graze with them for seven years,
source_units.display_text: let his body be changed by heaven’s dew, and let him graze with them for seven years,

source_units.text: until he knows that the Lord of heaven has authority over everything in heaven and upon earth, and does among them whatever He wills.’
source_units.display_text: until he knows that the Lord of heaven has authority over everything in heaven and upon earth, and does among them whatever He wills.’

source_units.text: Before me it was cut down in one day, and its destruction came within one hour of the day. Its branches were given to every wind; it was dragged away and thrown down. It ate the grass of the earth with the wild animals of the earth, was handed over to custody, and was bound by them in fetters and bronze handcuffs. I was greatly astonished at all this, and sleep departed from my eyes.
source_units.display_text: Before me it was cut down in one day, and its destruction came within one hour of the day. Its branches were given to every wind; it was dragged away and thrown down. It ate the grass of the earth with the wild animals of the earth, was handed over to custody, and was bound by them in fetters and bronze handcuffs. I was greatly astonished at all this, and sleep departed from my eyes.

source_units.text: In the morning I rose from my bed and called Daniel, chief of the learned experts and leader of those who judge dreams. I recounted the dream to him, and he explained its entire interpretation to me.
source_units.display_text: In the morning I rose from my bed and called Daniel, chief of the learned experts and leader of those who judge dreams. I recounted the dream to him, and he explained its entire interpretation to me.

source_units.text: Daniel was greatly astonished, and apprehension pressed upon him. Frightened, seized with trembling, and changed in appearance, he shook his head and remained astonished for an hour. He answered me in a gentle voice, ‘O king, may this dream come upon those who hate you and its interpretation upon your enemies!
source_units.display_text: Daniel was greatly astonished, and apprehension pressed upon him. Frightened, seized with trembling, and changed in appearance, he shook his head and remained astonished for an hour. He answered me in a gentle voice, ‘O king, may this dream come upon those who hate you and its interpretation upon your enemies!

source_units.text: You, O king, are the tree planted in the earth, whose appearance was great.
source_units.display_text: You, O king, are the tree planted in the earth, whose appearance was great.

source_units.text: And all the birds of heaven nesting in it—the strength of the earth and of the nations and of all languages to the ends of the earth, and all countries—serve you.
source_units.display_text: And all the birds of heaven nesting in it—the strength of the earth and of the nations and of all languages to the ends of the earth, and all countries—serve you.

source_units.text: The raising of that tree, its reaching heaven, and its mass touching the clouds mean that you, O king, were raised above all people upon the face of the whole earth. Your heart was raised in pride and strength against the Holy One and His angels. Your deeds were seen, because you laid waste the house of the living God on account of the sins of the consecrated people.
source_units.display_text: The raising of that tree, its reaching heaven, and its mass touching the clouds mean that you, O king, were raised above all people upon the face of the whole earth. Your heart was raised in pride and strength against the Holy One and His angels. Your deeds were seen, because you laid waste the house of the living God on account of the sins of the consecrated people.

source_units.text: The vision you saw, that an angel was sent in strength from the Lord and commanded the tree’s removal and cutting down, means that the judgment of the great God will come upon you,
source_units.display_text: The vision you saw, that an angel was sent in strength from the Lord and commanded the tree’s removal and cutting down, means that the judgment of the great God will come upon you,

source_units.text: and the Most High and His angels are rushing against you.
source_units.display_text: and the Most High and His angels are rushing against you.

source_units.text: They will lead you away into custody and send you to a deserted place.
source_units.display_text: They will lead you away into custody and send you to a deserted place.

source_units.text: The root of the tree that was left, since it was not uprooted, means that the place of your throne will be preserved for you for a time and an hour. Behold! They are preparing against you; they will scourge you and bring the judgments upon you.
source_units.display_text: The root of the tree that was left, since it was not uprooted, means that the place of your throne will be preserved for you for a time and an hour. Behold! They are preparing against you; they will scourge you and bring the judgments upon you.

source_units.text: The Lord lives in heaven, and His authority is over all the earth. Entreat Him concerning your sins, and redeem all your injustices by almsgiving, so that gentleness may be granted you, you may have many days upon your royal throne, and He may not destroy you. Love these words, for my word is accurate and your time is full.’”
source_units.display_text: The Lord lives in heaven, and His authority is over all the earth. Entreat Him concerning your sins, and redeem all your injustices by almsgiving, so that gentleness may be granted you, you may have many days upon your royal throne, and He may not destroy you. Love these words, for my word is accurate and your time is full.’”

source_units.text: At the completion of the words, Nebuchadnezzar, when he heard the judgment of the vision, kept the words in his heart.
source_units.display_text: At the completion of the words, Nebuchadnezzar, when he heard the judgment of the vision, kept the words in his heart.

source_units.text: After twelve months, the king was walking upon the city walls with all his glory and passing over its towers.
source_units.display_text: After twelve months, the king was walking upon the city walls with all his glory and passing over its towers.

source_units.text: He spoke and said, “This is great Babylon, which I built, and it will be called the house of my kingship through the strength of my might, for the honor of my glory.”
source_units.display_text: He spoke and said, “This is great Babylon, which I built, and it will be called the house of my kingship through the strength of my might, for the honor of my glory.”

source_units.text: At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

source_units.text: The angels will pursue you for seven years. You will neither be seen nor speak with any human being. They will feed you grass like an ox, and your pasture will be the earth’s greenery. Behold! In place of your glory they will bind you, and another will have your luxurious house and your kingdom.

source_units.text: “I, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, was bound for seven years. They fed me grass like an ox, and I ate the earth’s greenery. source_units.text: My hair became like an eagle’s wings, and my nails like a lion’s. My flesh and my heart were changed; I walked naked with the wild animals of the earth. I saw a dream, and apprehensions seized me. After a time a deep sleep took hold of me, and drowsiness fell upon me.

source_units.text: At the completion of the seven years, the time of my release came. My sins and my acts of ignorance reached their full measure before the God of heaven. I entreated the great God of gods concerning my acts of ignorance, and an angel called to me from heaven, saying, ‘Nebuchadnezzar, serve the holy God of heaven and give glory to the Most High; the kingship of your nation is restored to you.’

source_units.text: I give thanks to the Most High and praise Him who created heaven and earth, seas and rivers, and everything in them. I give thanks and praise, for He is God of gods, Lord of lords, and King of kings. He performs signs and wonders and changes seasons and times, taking kingdoms from kings and appointing others in their place.

source_units.text: From now on I will worship Him. Trembling has seized me through fear of Him, and I praise all His holy ones. For the gods of the nations have no strength in themselves to transfer one king’s kingdom to another king, to kill and make alive, to perform signs and great and fearsome wonders, or to change exceedingly great affairs, as the God of heaven has done in me, changing great affairs concerning me. Throughout all the days of my reign I will offer sacrifices to the Most High on behalf of my soul, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord. I will do what is acceptable before Him—I and my people, my nation and my countries under my authority. Whoever has spoken against the God of heaven, and whoever is caught speaking anything against Him, I will condemn to death.”

source_units.text: King Nebuchadnezzar wrote a circular letter to all the nations in every place, to the countries and all languages dwelling in every country, from generation to generation: “Praise the Lord, the God of heaven, and gloriously bring Him sacrifice and offering. I, king of kings, gloriously give thanks to Him, because He has dealt with me in this way: on that very day He seated me upon my throne; I regained my authority and my kingdom among my people, and my greatness was restored to me.”

source_units.text: “King Nebuchadnezzar to all nations, all countries, and all who dwell in them: May peace be multiplied to you at every time. Now I will explain to you the deeds that the great God has done with me. It pleased me to demonstrate to you and to your learned experts that there is a God, and His wonders are great; His kingship is an everlasting kingship, His authority from generation to generation.” He sent letters concerning everything that had happened to him in his kingdom to all the nations under his kingship.

source_units.text: King Baltasar held a great reception on the day of the dedication of his royal buildings and invited two thousand men from among his magnates. On that day Baltasar, elated by wine and boasting, praised all the nations’ cast and carved gods in his place, but gave no praise to God Most High. That very night fingers like a human’s came out and inscribed on the plaster of his house’s wall, opposite the lamp, “Mane, Phares, Thekel.” Their interpretation is: Mane, “It has been numbered”; Phares, “It has been taken away”; Thekel, “It has been weighed.”

triples.rationale: Chronicles also places Nebuchadnezzar's attack in the reign of Judah's Jehoiakim, called Joakim here. The connection concerns the named rulers and Babylonian assault; it does not harmonize the accounts' regnal dates.
triples.source_text: In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.

target_units.text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zechora, daughter of Nerias from Rama. He did what was evil before the Lord, according to everything his fathers had done.
In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came into the land, and he served him for three years and then revolted against him.

The Lord sent against them the Chaldeans, bands of Syrian raiders, bands of Moabite raiders, and the sons of Ammon and of Samaria. They withdrew after this event, according to the Lord’s word through His servants the prophets.
Nevertheless the Lord’s anger was against Judah, to remove him from His presence because of Manasseh’s sins in everything he had done,
and because of the innocent blood that Jehoiakim shed, filling Jerusalem with innocent blood; yet the Lord did not wish to destroy them.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, bound him with bronze fetters, and took him away to Babylon.

triples.rationale: Nebuchadnezzar's dream disturbs his sleep; Pharaoh likewise dreams and is troubled when morning comes, then seeks interpretation. Both court narratives begin with a ruler troubled by a dream.
triples.source_text: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, the king fell into visions and dreams and was disturbed in his dream, and his sleep left him.

target_units.text: And after two full years Pharaoh dreamed a dream. He thought he was standing beside the river.
And behold, as though from the river there came up seven cows, fair in appearance and choice in flesh, and they grazed among the reeds.
And seven other cows came up after them from the river, ugly in appearance and lean in flesh, and they grazed beside the cows upon the riverbank.
And the seven cows which were ugly and lean in flesh devoured the seven cows which were fair in appearance and choice. And Pharaoh awoke.
And he dreamed a second time, and behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, choice and good.
And seven other ears sprouted after them, thin and blighted by the wind.

triples.rationale: The impressive statue introduced in the dream becomes the subject of Daniel's announced interpretation, which identifies its successive materials with royal powers. The connection follows the account's own explanation of its image.
triples.source_text: You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.

target_units.text: This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.
You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.
Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.
After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.
A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.
As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.
The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.
As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.

triples.rationale: Daniel attributes Nebuchadnezzar's kingship and power to the God of heaven. The later heavenly sentence removes his kingdom and declares that God gives human kingship to whomever He wishes.

target_units.text: At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

actual_target_units.text: At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

triples.rationale: The gold head is identified with Nebuchadnezzar's extensive dominion over living creatures; the later tree vision also identifies its great, sheltering image with the king and the peoples serving him.
triples.source_text: Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.

target_units.text: You, O king, are the tree planted in the earth, whose appearance was great.
And all the birds of heaven nesting in it—the strength of the earth and of the nations and of all languages to the ends of the earth, and all countries—serve you.

The raising of that tree, its reaching heaven, and its mass touching the clouds mean that you, O king, were raised above all people upon the face of the whole earth. Your heart was raised in pride and strength against the Holy One and His angels. Your deeds were seen, because you laid waste the house of the living God on account of the sins of the consecrated people.

context_units.text: And the chief cupbearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my offence today.
“Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put us in custody in the house of the chief cook, me and the chief baker.
“And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; each of us saw his own dream.
“And a young Hebrew servant of the chief cook was with us, and we told him, and he interpreted to us.
“And as he interpreted to us, so it happened: I was restored to my office, and he was hanged.”
And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph; and they brought him out of the fortress, and shaved him, and changed his garments; and he came to Pharaoh.
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is none to interpret it; but I have heard it said concerning you, that when you hear dreams, you can interpret them.”

triples.rationale: Royal officials are summoned to the image's dedication; officials later gather to inspect the men whom the fire has not harmed. The two assemblies frame demanded worship and public evidence of rescue.
triples.source_text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of kings and lord of the whole inhabited world, sent to gather all the nations, tribes, and languages, satraps, generals, district governors, consuls, administrators, those holding authority in each country, and everyone throughout the inhabited world, to come to the dedication of the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

target_units.text: The consuls, district governors, ancestral chiefs, and the king’s friends gathered. They observed those men: the fire had not touched their bodies, their hair had not burned, their trousers were unchanged, and there was no smell of fire on them.

target_units.text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.
Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”

triples.rationale: The king now calls the three men out of the fire as servants of the Most High. Earlier he had ordered those same men bound and thrown into it; his new command reverses their confinement.
triples.source_text: The king approached the door of the furnace blazing with fire and called them by name: “Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, servants of the Most High God of gods, come out of the fire!” Thus the men came out from the midst of the fire.

Then those men were bound hand and foot, wearing their footwear and the tiaras on their heads, together with their clothing, and were thrown into the furnace.

triples.relationship: shared promise and narrative of preservation in fire
triples.rationale: The inspection finds no burning of the men's bodies or hair and no fire damage to their clothing. Isaiah's assurance to Israel explicitly describes passing through fire without being burned, the particular deliverance narrated here.
triples.source_text: The consuls, district governors, ancestral chiefs, and the king’s friends gathered. They observed those men: the fire had not touched their bodies, their hair had not burned, their trousers were unchanged, and there was no smell of fire on them.

target_units.text: Even if you cross through water, I am with you, and rivers will not flood over you. Even if you pass through fire, you will certainly not be burned up; flame will not burn you up.

triples.relationship: same-chapter confession confirming the companions' answer
triples.rationale: The king credits their God and His angel with rescue and recalls their refusal to worship another god. Both rescue and exclusive allegiance were expressed in the companions' earlier answer to him.
triples.source_text: King Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, who sent His angel and saved His servants who hoped in Him. They rejected the king’s command and surrendered their bodies to burning so that they would neither serve nor bow to another god except their own God.

target_units.text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.
Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”
